as_told.title: Phyllis Schlemmer's channeled book and the Nine

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a woman named Phyllis Schlemmer, who wrote a book called The Only Planet of Choice. In it she channels "the Nine", meaning she says she passes on messages from a group of unseen beings by that name. Michels says that, as he understands it, their messages call Earth a bottleneck of consciousness, a place that minds must squeeze through, which would make our planet special in some larger scheme.
